name: Tranquil Gardens Cemetery
summary: Southeast of Darkshire, Tranquil Gardens Cemetery is overrun by shambling skeletons and ghouls. The dead make it a danger to the nearby town.

sections.title: Restless Grounds
sections.body: Once the people of Grand Hamlet laid their dead in Tranquil Gardens Cemetery. Then dark curses settled over Duskwood, and the buried began clawing out of their plots. Skeletal warriors and mages haunt the gravestones, along with wandering undead. They are weaker than the horrors deeper in the woods, but their nearness to Darkshire makes them a constant threat to the townsfolk.

sections.title: On the Town's Threshold
sections.body: Tranquil Gardens Cemetery lies near Darkshire's edge, where the Night Watch holds its line. The Watch sends fresh recruits and arriving adventurers to thin the rising dead before they reach the settlement. Yet more dangerous foes lurk among the tumbled headstones and the ruined chapel. The Insane Ghoul is one of them.

faq.q: Why is it called Tranquil Gardens if it is full of undead?
faq.answer: Tranquil Gardens Cemetery was established when Darkshire was still Grand Hamlet, a peaceful settlement in a sunlit forest. Local families meant it to be a quiet and dignified resting place. The name turned grimly ironic when the curse fell over the region and the dead began rising from their graves.

faq.q: What threats wander around the cemetery?
faq.answer: Shambling skeletons, skeletal warriors and skeletal mages haunt the grounds. A particularly vicious Insane Ghoul haunts the ruined chapel or roams among the headstones.

faq.q: Why does the Night Watch send recruits here?
faq.answer: The cemetery sits immediately southeast of Darkshire, and unchecked undead threaten to spill into town. The Night Watch sends recruits there to face weaker undead before they enter the dangerous forest.

faq.q: Who lives just north of the cemetery?
faq.answer: Just north of Tranquil Gardens Cemetery, an isolated cottage is home to Blind Mary, a spirit who lingers near the blighted graveyard.

angles.text: As a paladin, you face an affront to the Holy Light in Tranquil Gardens Cemetery. There, you prove yourself by bringing peace to Duskwood's restless dead.
As an Alliance champion arriving in Darkshire, you help defend the nearby graveyard and keep the town's perimeter safe from the undead.
